evidence.title: Motion & Framer Motion upgrade guide | Motion for React

name: Motion & Framer Motion upgrade guide
summary: Official upgrade guide for Motion for React: breaking API changes per major version, from Framer Motion 6.0 through Motion 14.0.
description: Step-by-step upgrade notes between Motion for React versions. Each major version section documents the breaking changes — velocity calculation and render scheduling in 11.0, the removed IntersectionObserver fallback and exitBeforeEnter error in 10.0, pointer events in 8.0, the framer-motion to motion/react import swap in 12.0 — plus how to run the upgrade automatically with the Motion AI Kit. The framer.com URL now redirects to motion.dev/docs/react-upgrade-guide.
contains: upgrade notes for every major version: 6.0 to 14.0
11.0: velocity calculation and render scheduling changes, Jest test caveat
12.0: swap imports from framer-motion to motion/react
13.0: @emotion/is-prop-valid removed in favour of explicit injection
10.0: IntersectionObserver fallback removed, exitBeforeEnter now throws
9.0: whileFocus behaves like :focus-visible; tap listeners get tabindex 0
